narrativeProgression.description: Bob Price introduces Greg Abbott and his candidacy for Governor of Texas.
Bob Price asks Greg Abbott why he would give up his current position as Attorney General to become Governor.
Greg Abbott explains his motivation and vision for Texas.
Bob Price asks about Greg Abbott's leadership in lawsuit reform and the positive business environment of Texas.
Bob Price asks about the demand for infrastructure due to growth in Texas and how to address it responsibly.
Bob Price asks about the impact of federal lawsuit reform legislation on Texas.
Bob Price asks about recent pro-life legislation passed in Texas and Greg Abbott's stance on defending it.
Bob Price asks about Texas' role as the energy capital and the impact of the Eagle Ford Shale.
Bob Price congratulates Greg Abbott on his candidacy and thanks him for his service.
